description: Machine-verifiable IDE capability baseline. Every domain anchors to real repo paths. This file is a product engineering artifact, not a scorecard.

benchmark_peers.description: VSCode — lightweight workbench, LSP, DAP, command palette, extension model
IntelliJ IDEA Community — deep semantic project model, inspections, safe refactoring
Codex — agentic coding with sandbox, permission, audit trail, patch-first workflow
OpenCode — terminal-native agentic workflow, command catalog, LSP/diagnostics awareness

workbench.target: Vityo shell with command palette, quick open, surface routing, capability-aware command availability, and keyboard-navigable workbench areas.
workbench.currentStatus: L3 — Product Workflow (command palette, quick open, navigation, surface routing all wired through shell)
knownGaps: Agent-visible command filtering newly added (needs integration test)
Keyboard navigation in palette UI needs widget test
No chord keybinding support yet
workbench.nextMilestone: L4 — cross-platform keyboard navigation verified; agent command filtering integration-tested

editor_engine.target: Styio Source Buffer with visual substitution, semantic block surface, undo/redo, cursor/selection, large-file degradation policy, and multi-cursor support.
editor_engine.currentStatus: L3 — Product Workflow (document model, selection, undo/redo, keyboard editing, visual substitution toggle exist; large-file policy documented)
knownGaps: Multi-cursor not implemented
Large-file (>10K lines) degradation policy documented but not tested
IME composition not verified on CJK platforms
editor_engine.nextMilestone: L4 — large-file perf test; CJK IME verification on at least one platform

language_intelligence.target: Token/semantic highlighting, diagnostics, hover, completion, formatting, go-to-definition, find-references, rename, code actions, workspace symbols — all through LanguageServiceAdapter contract with stale-result rejection and capability-gap safety.
language_intelligence.currentStatus: L2-L3 — Contract-backed diagnostics, stale-revision rejection, capability gap model; workspace features exist with upstream-blocked status for rename/code-actions/formatting
knownGaps: Rename safety blocked on upstream StyioService
Code actions (intentions) blocked on upstream StyioService
Formatting provider blocked on upstream StyioService
Hover/completion providers blocked on upstream StyioService
Inlay hints not yet designed
language_intelligence.nextMilestone: L3 — consume real StyioService diagnostics; wire code action preview/apply through workspace edit transaction

project_model.target: Owner-contract project model: Pafio metadata for local package/workspace facts, Styio machine-info for compiler truth, and Platform hosted-workspace v1 for remote state.
project_model.currentStatus: L3 — Contract-backed owner adapters, four-layer workspace display, and Agent-context serialization
knownGaps: Owner-source marking is not rendered on every field
Package target ambiguity shows generic blocked reason
project_model.nextMilestone: L3 — render per-field owner provenance without reading private upstream state

run_debug_runtime.target: Runtime surface as first-class product: run target selector, minimal compilable unit run, workflow lane summaries, stdout/stderr/diagnostic event stream, runtime graph, event replay, route trace. Breakpoint/run-configuration model as preview-only until Styio backend supports them.
run_debug_runtime.currentStatus: L3 — Product Workflow (execution adapter, runtime event adapter, four workflow lanes, replay summary, lane summaries wired through shell)
knownGaps: Structured blocked reasons for ambiguous/missing target implicit in execution adapter
Breakpoint model not yet defined
Run configuration model not yet formalized
Live event streaming (currently compile-plan artifact replay)
Debug step/stack/variable introspection blocked on upstream Styio runtime
run_debug_runtime.nextMilestone: L4 — breakpoint/run-config model; structured blocked reasons; live streaming when upstream supports it

agent_workflow.target: Agent Workbench and open Agent Client: versioned protocol connection to Vityo Coding Agent or another compatible Agent; scoped context export; plan and permission review; revision-bound patch preview/apply/rollback through IDE workspace transactions; verification receipts; explicit disconnected state while edit/analyze/test/run/observe remain available. Model/provider routing is Agent-runtime-owned.
agent_workflow.currentStatus: L3 — Vityo collaborates only through the versioned Agent Client boundary; IDE-owned model/provider, prompt-profile, coding-loop, and session-controller surfaces have been removed. Workbench projections, permission presentation, and workspace transactions remain IDE-owned.
knownGaps: Focused regression still needs to confirm Agent Client/Workbench/transaction acceptance after this migration
Protocol-backed multi-session product evidence remains on the focused acceptance path
agent_workflow.nextMilestone: L4 — focused Agent Client/Workbench/transaction acceptance and repository boundary gates prove the protocol-only IDE boundary without ide/full

module_system.target: Core/optional module lifecycle with manifest, capability matrix, staged update, install/uninstall/disable, platform-aware entry hiding, and data reclamation policy.
module_system.currentStatus: L2-L3 — Contract-backed module lifecycle, manifest, registry, capability matrix exist; real package download/staging/activation not yet implemented
knownGaps: Real package download/staging/activation path not implemented
Platform file deletion and resource reclaim not implemented
module_system.nextMilestone: L3 — real package download and staged activation

source_control.target: Source control adapter contract: SourceControlSnapshot, SourceControlChange, SourceControlProviderKind, LocalHistorySnapshot. Desktop may express local git candidate; Web/iOS default blocked or hosted-controlled. No real destructive git operations.
source_control.currentStatus: L1 — Local Model (adapter contract, snapshot model, capability-gap-safe; no real git execution)
knownGaps: No real git integration (by design — requires permission model and approval flow)
LocalHistorySnapshot not yet persisted
Hosted route source control state not yet modeled
source_control.nextMilestone: L2 — real git status read (not write); local history persistence

settings_keymap_profile.target: Schema-owned settings with migration, provider-neutral local-first profiles, optional sync, and secret redaction. Theme covers IDE shell, editor, semantic blocks, glyphs, diagnostics, runtime, Agent Workbench, focus, and selection.
settings_keymap_profile.currentStatus: L2 — Contract-backed (ConfigurationStore migrations, theme overrides, command-palette preferences, keybinding profiles, domain-specific shell/test/debug profiles, and secret redaction; no IDE-owned Agent prompt or provider profile)
knownGaps: Theme editor UI not implemented
General provider-neutral user profile store not implemented
Cross-session profile sync not implemented (optional)
settings_keymap_profile.nextMilestone: L3 — theme editor UI; provider-neutral local profile contract

security_trust.target: Correlated permission presentation for Agent requests, capability-gated IDE MCP tools, IDE-owned workspace transactions, and secret redaction in all display/context projections. No-Agent local mode remains fully functional.
security_trust.currentStatus: L2 — Contract-backed (AgentPermissionRequest with one-shot decisions, CollaborationStore lifecycle projection, MCP tool grants and workspace-root authorization, RevisionedIdeContextExportService sanitization, and IDE-owned workspace transactions)
knownGaps: Workspace trust model not yet formalized
Toolchain execution sandboxing not implemented
security_trust.nextMilestone: L3 — workspace trust model; toolchain execution permission gating

cross_platform_hosted_workspace.target: Desktop (local-first), Android (local-first with cloud fallback), iOS (cloud-only), Web (hosted workspace). Each platform exposes only compatible capabilities. Hosted workspace has retention/export lifecycle.
cross_platform_hosted_workspace.currentStatus: L2-L3 — Contract-backed platform target model, hosted workspace record, hosted control plane client, cloud adapter routes exist; cross-platform matrix validation incomplete
knownGaps: Cross-platform matrix validation incomplete
Hosted workspace retention/export UX not validated
Mobile interaction matrix not tested
cross_platform_hosted_workspace.nextMilestone: L4 — cross-platform matrix test; hosted workspace lifecycle UX validated

performance_accessibility.target: Editor input <16ms latency, keyboard-navigable all surfaces, screen-reader semantics, contrast ≥4.5:1 for editor text, no-overflow layout rule, narrow viewport adaptation, telemetry-free local metrics only.
performance_accessibility.currentStatus: L1-L2 — Local Model (interaction quality bar documented; no automated overflow detection; no latency measurement baseline; no screen-reader verification)
knownGaps: No automated overflow detection widget test
No keyboard-navigation-only integration test
No contrast ratio automation
No large-file performance test
performance_accessibility.nextMilestone: L2 — automated overflow test; keyboard navigation integration test; contrast check script
